summary: Project details wireless charging of vehicle
details:
Wireless charging of vehicles in space is an emerging technology that uses Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) to recharge spacecraft, lunar rovers, planetary exploration vehicles, and potentially space-based electric transport systems without conventional plug-in electrical connections.

It is an extension of terrestrial Dynamic Wireless Power Transfer (DWPT), but space introduces additional challenges such as vacuum, extreme temperatures, radiation, large air gaps and precise alignment.
